image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a cluster of toilet paper rolls. One roll is prominently displayed in the foreground left with its cardboard core visible, showing a dark patterned interior. Another roll sits behind it to the right, also showing a brown cardboard core. A third roll is partially visible at the top, appearing somewhat deformed or squashed. A green package, likely containing more tissue or wipes, is visible at the bottom center. The background is a plain, light-colored wall or surface.
